title: Add-new-function by Mirror code only
hypothesis: A frozen function interpreter can add phase-orbit functions from support examples via compact signature+phase codes and sparse private residuals, with lower complete payload than direct coefficients or independent function modules.
mirror_coordinate: signature index plus one phase per function; sparse two-value fifth-harmonic residual for off-orbit functions
logical_multiplicity: 32 new functions per world from support examples only
controls: direct sine/cosine coefficient fitting plus same private residual
fixture: 32 functions: 24 targets sin(freq*x+phase), freq in {1,2,3}; 8 targets add 0.25*sin(5*x+psi). 16 support x/y examples per function; 512 heldout query x values.

development.selection_metric: on-orbit/off-orbit normalized MSE, actual serialized bytes per bank/function, code-discovery operations and wall time

fresh.run_only_if: not run: development byte/compute gates failed

paid_objects: Mirror phases or direct coefficient pairs

success_gate: Both development worlds: Mirror on-orbit nMSE<=1e-5, off-orbit nMSE<=1e-4, Mirror payload<=0.80x direct coefficients, and phase-search compute<=10x direct fitting; fresh uses same gates.
failure_gate: Any quality/byte/compute gate miss or exact direct-control output/byte alias.
boundaries: Analytic Fourier function family; no learned interpreter or natural tasks.
Support phase search is charged; no oracle task ID beyond provided examples.
